title: Animated Switch
subtitle: A toggle between on and off.

descriptions.variant: Elastic stretches the thumb as it moves; Apple copies the iOS switch.
descriptions.color: Track colour when the switch is on.
descriptions.appleGreen: Uses iOS green for the on track. Only for the Apple type with On colour set to Foreground.
descriptions.rounded: Corner radius of the track and thumb.
descriptions.showMarks: Shows on and off marks inside the track.
descriptions.labelPosition: Where the label sits relative to the switch.
descriptions.pressSqueeze: How much the thumb squashes when pressed (Elastic) or widens (Apple, which stops changing above about 0.27).
descriptions.duration: How long the thumb takes to move, in seconds.
descriptions.bounce: Springiness of the thumb when it lands. 0 means no overshoot.

Tip: press and hold to see the handle squeeze before you let go. On Apple, drag the handle across.

themeDescription: Colour palette for the track, thumb, marks and focus ring. Primary uses its primary colour; Green, Blue, Orange and Rose use its success, info, warning and destructive colours.
